markdown:
# Independent Workflow Judge

Verdict: PASS.

The exact pinned source was evaluated against the approved spec/design, all R1-R24 criteria, the changed-file inventory, compact patch/index evidence, and the required digest-bound Verification artifact. Verification reports full-feature PASS for build/typecheck, lint/format, unit, integration, end-to-end contracts, runtime, and applicable UI disposition, with native provider receipts/results explicitly left as a separate Judge obligation.

No supported findings were identified. The implementation preserves the approved boundaries: advisory review is source-bound and noncertifying; formal Judge input excludes advisory/history material; compact review construction preserves whole-feature scope, renames, binaries, and assembled source; retry orchestration is guarded and repeat-safe; recovery requires explicit source-bound whole-feature waiver and remaining evidence; and packaged guidance/resources are consistent across portable adapters.

Scope, gap, and contradiction checks all pass.
